newsitem.title: USA: Four junk deals to hit U.S. corporate bond market.
newsitem.headline: Four junk deals to hit U.S. corporate bond market.

text.p: Four new high-yield bond offerings were expected to hit the U.S. corporate bond market by the end of the week as issuers rushed to tap strong demand for new paper from junk investors, market pros said.
Adelphia Communications Corp, a Coudersport, Penn.-based cable company, is speedily putting together a 144a offering of at least $200 million in senior notes via Smith Barney Inc.
The company said it will use the proceeds from the offering to redeem a portion of its 12-1/2 percent notes which become callable in May, as well as to pay down bank debt.
